name: PLS
recent: PLS Plantations 正在筹备第39届年度股东大会，并寻求股东批准续期经常性关联交易授权。公司也发布了2026财年年度报告，并定期公布月度产量数据。最新季度财报显示营收环比增长30.8%，但净亏损扩大至916万令吉。
notable: 将于2026年12月2日召开第39届年度股东大会。
以进行经常性关联交易。
risks: 最新季度净亏损916万令吉，较去年同期大幅扩大。
净亏损率从上一季度的17.7%扩大至36.4%。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度营收为2518万令吉，环比增长30.8%，同比增长3.0%；净亏损为916万令吉，净亏损率36.4%，较上一季度的17.7%扩大。

recent_en: PLS Plantations is preparing for its 39th AGM and seeking shareholders' approval to renew the mandate for recurrent related party transactions. The company also released its FY2026 annual report and regularly publishes monthly production figures. The latest quarterly results show revenue up 30.8% QoQ but net loss widened to RM9.16 million.
notable_en: Proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net loss of RM9.16 million, significantly wider than a year ago.
Net loss margin widened to 36.4% from 17.7% in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: 4Q FY2026 revenue was RM25.18 million, up 30.8% QoQ and 3.0% YoY; net loss was RM9.16 million with a net loss margin of 36.4%, wider than 17.7% in the previous quarter.
